propositions: Current clarity measure duplicated across gates.py and det_floor.py rewards volume and legacy shape rather than enforcing author-guide leaf/container contract, risking drift and false passes.
Clarity scoring lacks deterministic checks for required sections (Context/Problem, Approach for leaves, AC for all), per-AC verification coverage, and placeholder language in Scope/Approach.
Author guide and G6 criteria conflict on rejected-alternative requirement; Success Criteria heading is inert in tests but still requested in user docs.
Per-AC verification coverage and placeholder detection can be mechanically testable without semantic judgment, whereas persona quality and positive-rationale quality must remain LLM-reviewed.

Recommended deterministic additions should return per-check evidence and derive compatibility score from satisfied/applicable checks, not accumulate points on current scale where filler compensates for missing sections.
